name: Gen1Dex
description: The Pokedex with a POKeMON beside every entry: the party icon to the left of each row, blacked out to a silhouette until you have seen that species, and every one you have in its own colours. SELECT cycles the list between numbered, A-Z and caught only. An entry is three pages A moves between -- the vanilla page with its sprite and description, then base stats with BST, types and evolutions, then the full movelist of level-up moves and TM/HM with same-type moves marked.
